newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank repo allocates 9.5 bln Skr to market.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank repo allocates 9.5 bln Skr to market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it injected 9.5 billion crowns into the market in this morning's weekly repurchase operation.

The repurchase rate was set at a fixed rate of 4.10 percent, unchanged from last week's rate. It will run from May 21 to May 28 and replaces an operation which allocated eight billion crowns to the market.
The Riksbank said 36.68 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated.
